Serves 2 Ingredients: 200g spaghetti Servings: 4 4 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp olive oil 1/4 cup parmesan Salt to taste Calories: 108cal Method:
Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Saute garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Toss pasta with garlic oil and parmesan. Serve immediately.
Classic Margherita Pizza Serves 1 large pizza Ingredients:
Cook Time: 15 mins 2 1/2 cups bread flour
1/2 cup tomato sauce 200g fresh mozzarella Fresh basil leaves
Method: Mix flour, yeast and salt. Add warm water and knead 10 minutes.
Let dough rise for 1 hour in a warm spot.
Preheat oven to 250°C with a pizza stone inside.
Shape dough into a 12-inch circle. Spread sauce, tear mozzarella on top. Bake 8-10 minutes until crust is golden. Top with fresh basil.
